content:
There are a bunch of AI fellowships being advertised at Imperial right now, see e.g. here. I've had people apply to this institution ("Imperial X") before, saying "I want to formalise mathematics like Kevin", and they have not been successful, it's not AI enough. However if people want to think about integrating AI and Lean with applications to mathematics then I think they would have a stronger chance for these jobs (and it's perhaps worth noting that some of the people involved with the DeepMind AlphaProof work are at Imperial; DeepMind is based in London).

If people have questions then I would encourage them to DM me directly rather than replying here; discussions are generally discouraged in #announce .

If you are interested in using AI for formalising analysis and probability feel free to get in touch. Only a few days left before the deadline.

https://www.imperial.ac.uk/ix-ai-in-science/apply/
